jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales (scheme-wide dates)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide window for all participating NSW employers: applications open 9:00am Wednesday 9 June 2027; the Law Society publishes two alternate closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027) depending on the employer, so no single close date can be stated — offers may be made from 9:00am Wednesday 8 September 2027 and must be accepted or declined by 1:00pm Thursday 9 September 2027; eligibility is penultimate (or final) year of your law degree.

jobs.program: Graduate Program 2027 recruitment round (NSW Graduate Recruitment Program)
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide market-offer window for participating NSW employers: applications open 9:00am Monday 22 February 2027 and close 11:59pm Sunday 4 April 2027, with interviews from Tuesday 27 April 2027 and offers from 9:00am Wednesday 2 June 2027.

The firm's own early-careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, with a pre-registration link, but no exact 2027 open or close date has been published yet — the published dates on the page still relate to the completed 2026/27 round.

The firm's Australian early-careers page confirms 2026/27 applications are closed and that information on 2027/2028 applications will be released in early 2027; every date field on the page (open, close, offers, program dates) is currently marked TBC, so no dates can be confirmed.

The firm's graduate site states applications for the May 2027 program will open in March 2027 (clerkship rounds for 2026/27 are closed), but no specific open or close date is published, and the relevant intake office is not clearly specified on the page.

The firm's application-process page confirms 2026/2027 clerkship applications are closed and that 2027/28 applications will open in early 2027, but gives no exact date; applicants must supply a covering letter, CV and academic transcript.
